noMediaReason: Operate revenue desk has no media frame; chart is inline SVG.

content.text: Decide which at-risk renewals need an owner before Friday commit. The desk carries ARR risk, unowned count, and days-to-commit so operators can open the next exception without hunting across chrome. Additional context covers renewals, expansions, pilots, and handoffs between account owners when the queue is dense.

ARR at risk summarizes the dollars that need an owner this week. Operators read the figure against last-thirty-day baseline, then open the next exception from the toolbar primary. Supporting copy stays short so the KPI stamp remains scannable under large-text stress.
